name: RecallRadar API
description: US product recalls from FDA, USDA FSIS, and CPSC in one schema. RecallRadar indexes public recall notices from the FDA, USDA FSIS, and CPSC. The official agency notice is the authoritative source. Always confirm details at the linked source before acting. Every row's source_url is the authoritative notice.
